Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report shows a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Eve, I enjoyed your blog! It's nice and clear that hiking is your favorite hobby. To make it even better, consider adding more detail such as favorite trails, photos, and personal stories from your hikes, plus some structure (posts, categories) for easier browsing.

Hi Dora, thanks for sharing your personal website! It's clean and gives your contact email upfront, which is handy. To improve it, consider adding more about yourself, such as your background, interests, and projects, along with some visuals and a clearer layout/navigation.
